name: Pink Horror

abilities.name: Frightful Form
abilities.text: Anyone that can see this threat must make a DN 3 Fear Test.

abilities.name: Magic Made Manifest
abilities.text: Spend 1 ruin to activate the Smite Psychic Power. This power is always activated at the Transcendent Power Level.

abilities.name: Split
abilities.text: The Pink Horror splits into two Blue Horrors.

determination: Daemonic Determination: Spend 1 Ruin to roll 3d6. Daemons can roll Determination against Mortal Wounds. Any Wounds negated by Determination are ignored instead of being converted to Shock.

options.name: Blue Horror
options.text: p.57. Own block without a Tier row or attributes row; attributes as the Pink Horror. DEFENCE 3, WOUNDS 11, SHOCK -, RESILIENCE 4. SKILLS: Default 8, Weapon Skill 10. Blue Horrors split into two Brimstone Horrors on death.

abilities.name: Magic Made Manifest
abilities.text: Spend 2 ruin to activate the Smite Psychic Power. This power is always activated at the Transcendent Power Level.

abilities.name: Split
abilities.text: The Blue Horror splits into two Brimstone Horrors

options.name: Brimstone Horror
options.text: p.57. Own block without a Tier row. S 1, T 3, A 1, I 1, Wil 3, Int 3, Fel 3. DEFENCE 3, WOUNDS 1, SHOCK -, RESILIENCE 4. SKILLS: Default 6. Conviction, Resolve, Speed and Size not printed; as the Pink Horror.

abilities.name: Magic Made Manifest
abilities.text: Spend 4 ruin to activate the Smite Psychic Power. This power is always activated at the Transcendent Power Level.

mobAbilities.name: Mob of Blue Horrors
mobAbilities.text: A Mob of Blue Horrors gains +1 bonus Icon to any Resolve Tests. This increases by +1 for every ten additional Blue Horrors.

note: Reprint of pink-horror; differs in Tier row (5), Wounds 11 (Core 5), skills, weapons, Resolve and Fear DN. Keyword PSKYER printed as such. Blue and Brimstone Horror blocks (p.57) kept as options. Mob ability printed under 'Mob Abilites' on the Blue Horror.
